title: Chemical interactions within biomass-burning emissions significantly influence the composition and optical properties of nanoscale secondary organic aerosols
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00770D, Paper
Shan Zhang, Kun Li, Li Xu, Lin Du
Furan–styrene interactions suppress secondary organic aerosol (SOA) yield and light absorption by inhibiting the formation of low-volatility and high absorptive compounds, revealing non-linear effects in biomass-burning emissions.
